label: Neuraltherapeutic Medicine in Post-Acute COVID-19 Vaccination Syndrome (PACVS): A Critical Review with a Case Report.
summary: IntroductionPost-acute COVID-19 vaccination syndrome (PACVS) emerges as a syndrome of persistent symptoms of a multisystemic nature, even in previously healthy people. Its pathophysiology involves a neural phase characterized by the neuroimmune reflex and persistent secondary neurogenic inflammation.
